_note: Roman + Iberian (a Lusitania analog): a Romanized-Iberian civ. Intra-Classical-family blend — Latinate/Romance structure over a Celtiberian substrate (-briga/-ica place-suffixes, Celtic-rooted rural names). Even split Lawful/Neutral. Seed names are coinages; no historical figures or real places.

phonology.palette: Latinate with Iberian substrate: -us/-a/-o endings; hard c; Celtic clusters br/nt; place-suffixes -briga/-ica beside Latinate -ia/-um.
phonology.phonotactics: CV / CVC; clusters st/tr/pr/br/nt; penultimate stress.

morphology.patronymic_form: Latinate gens (clan) for nobility; commoners patronymic -iz; Celtiberian roots in older rural names.
morphology.compounding_rule: [adjective|resource](stem) + feature-word, or feature + -briga (Ferrobriga = iron-fort); Latinate -ia/-um for cities.

title_ladder.government: feudal (Romanized provincial nobility over hillfort clans)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Romanized-Iberian: a Latinate ladder shifted toward Romance/Iberian forms (Conde/Condado, Duque/Ducado, Rege/Regno), distinguishing Lusan from the pure-Latinate Agrippan. Ascending barony..empire; march = Limitano (frontier).

people_name_convention.order: personal + gens (Latinate noble) OR personal + patronymic -iz (commoner/rural Iberian); optional cognomen.
people_name_convention.dual_register: Romanized nobility use Latinate gens; rural clans keep Celtiberian patronymics.
people_name_convention.theophoric: Latinate-Iberian devotional praenomina from the morphed deity-names (Tulrio-, Orlando-, Gaiando-).

religion._note: Deity-names are phoneme-morphs of the canonical (Agrippan) pantheon through Latinate-Iberian phonology (-o/-us endings, Romance shifts) — recognizably the same powers, never real Iberian gods. Lawful/Neutral; Roman state-cult forms over Iberian ancestral/mountain veneration.
religion.the_one: Aeterno (< Aeternus; the One, honored not petitioned)
religion.demon_epithet_pattern: each opposing power keeps its morphed name + a portfolio epithet (prefix 'o falso' or suffix '-tyranno'), distinct per power: Maraxus -> Maraxo the Burning Tyrant; Lusento -> Lusento the Coin-Serpent; Irantius -> Irancio the Restless.
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Collegio/Order of [power]: 'the Collegio of Tulrio'.
religion.saints_pattern: Divo/Diva [name]; rural cults venerate ancestral heroes at hillfort shrines.

banks_patterns.military_units: the [ordinal] Cohorte / the [clan] Spears: 'the Iron Cohorte'
banks_patterns.taverns: 'O [Adjective] [Noun]': 'O Galo Dourado' (golden cock), 'A Ancora de Ferro'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: 'as Ruinas de [name]': ruined castros and old Romanized villas
